dateTime.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format with UTC offset (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss±hh:mm). Responses use Norwegian time (Europe/Oslo) with seconds precision, so the offset is +01:00 in winter and +02:00 in summer. Requests accept any offset, including Z for UTC.

validFrom.description: Start of the validity period of the resource.

validTo.description: End of the validity period of the resource.

updatedAt.description: Time the resource was last updated.

agentIdentifier.description: External identifier used to resolve an agent. The type of agent is determined by the length: 9 digits for an organization number, 11 digits for a national identity number, and 13 digits for a GLN.

type.description: Type of agent. Person is a natural person, Organization is an organization identified by organization number, and MarketEntity is a market participant identified by GLN.

id.description: Identifier of the agent. The format depends on the agent type.

approvedByRelationship.description: Reference to the person who signed the document or approved the request.

authorizationGrantRelationship.description: References to the authorization grants created from this resource. Empty until the document is signed or the request is approved.

authorizationSourceRelationship.description: Reference to the authorization document or request the grant was created from.
